ev.q: Efforts also should be made to vaccinate persons aged 50--64 years.

notes: The epidemic threshold depends on a periodic baseline model stated only in a footnote, so the regression is primary; the 0.8% upward adjustment is a case-definition effect, not a procedure. Vaccine distribution and order percentages are supply measures, so vaccine_outcome_type is null. [review] The epidemic threshold is baseline plus 1.645 SD from the periodic regression, so comparing observed P&I to it is close to a one-sided test; inference is left as none because no test or CI is reported.
